# Pull requests that GitHub reports as merged, whose merge commit is not
# reachable from main, and whose content has been re-landed under a different
# PR.  Read by .github/scripts/check-merged-prs-landed.sh.
#
#   <stranded PR number> relanded-by <replacement PR number>
#
# This is NOT a mute.  The replacement is held to the same reachability test as
# everything else, so a line here only stops the alarm once the replacement is
# genuinely on main.  A waiver naming a PR that has not landed leaves the
# original reported, and says so.
#
# Re-landing is the repair; a waiver only records it.  Do not add a line here
# to quieten a PR whose content is still missing.

# #245 targeted `fix/probe-guard-contradicts-shipped-chart` instead of main and
# merged into it at 05:57:03Z, five minutes after #250 had merged that same
# branch into main at 05:51:54Z.  The branch stayed alive but was no longer a
# path to main, so 350 lines — including tests/unit/test_datasource_sql_driver_routing.py,
# 199 lines that exist nowhere on main — were absent from the release while the
# PR showed as merged and green.  Re-landed as a clean cherry-pick of 26a8c3b7.
245 relanded-by 256
